questions.question: Choose the noun form of 'decide'.
questions.explanation: The noun form of decide is decision.

questions.question: Choose the noun form of 'honest'.
questions.explanation: Honesty is the noun form.

questions.question: Identify the figure of speech: 'The wind whispered through the trees.'
questions.explanation: The wind is given the human action of whispering, so this is personification.

questions.question: Identify the figure of speech: 'He is as brave as a lion.'
questions.explanation: The comparison uses 'as', making it a simile.

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: She is good ___ English.
questions.explanation: The standard expression is 'good at English'.

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: He arrived ___ the station at six.
questions.explanation: We say 'arrived at the station'.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: She ___ to school every day.
questions.explanation: The singular subject 'she' takes 'goes' in the simple present.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: They ___ the work yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' requires the simple past: completed.

questions.question: Choose the correct tag: She is coming, ___.
questions.explanation: A positive statement with 'is' takes the negative tag 'isn't she?'.

questions.question: Choose the correct tag: They don't know him, ___.
questions.explanation: A negative statement with 'don't' takes the positive tag 'do they?'.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of 'give up'.
questions.explanation: Give up means to stop trying or surrender.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of 'look after'.
questions.explanation: Look after means take care of.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'The teacher praised Ravi.'
options: Ravi was praised by the teacher.
The teacher was praised by Ravi.
questions.explanation: The object Ravi becomes the subject in the passive form.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'They will finish the work tomorrow.'
options: The work will be finished by them tomorrow.
The work is finished tomorrow by them.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.question: Choose the correct question for the answer 'I went to Mysuru.'
questions.explanation: Simple past questions use did + base verb.

questions.question: Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: She sang beautifully.
questions.explanation: Beautifully modifies the verb sang, so it is an adverb.

questions.question: Change into reported speech: Ravi said, 'I am busy.'
questions.model_answer: Ravi said that he was busy.

questions.question: Change into reported speech: Mother said to me, 'Do your homework.'
questions.model_answer: Mother told me to do my homework.

questions.question: Change into reported speech: She said, 'I have finished the work.'
questions.model_answer: She said that she had finished the work.

questions.question: Combine into a simple sentence: He was tired. He continued working.
questions.model_answer: In spite of being tired, he continued working.

questions.question: Combine into a compound sentence: Work hard. You will succeed.
questions.model_answer: Work hard and you will succeed.

questions.question: Change into a complex sentence: In spite of his illness, he attended school.
questions.model_answer: Although he was ill, he attended school.

questions.question: Change into the comparative degree: Rani is the tallest girl in the class.
questions.model_answer: Rani is taller than any other girl in the class.

questions.question: Change into the positive degree: Mumbai is bigger than many other Indian cities.
questions.model_answer: Many other Indian cities are not as big as Mumbai.

questions.question: Change into the superlative degree: Very few metals are as useful as iron.
questions.model_answer: Iron is one of the most useful metals.

questions.question: Change into reported speech: The teacher said, 'Open your books.'
questions.model_answer: The teacher told the students to open their books.

questions.question: Choose the correct question: 'She has lived here for five years.'
options: How long has she lived here?
How long did she live here?
How long she has lived here?
How long does she lived here?
questions.explanation: Present perfect with a duration is correctly questioned with 'How long has... lived?'.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The medicine had a positive ___ on him.
questions.explanation: Effect is the noun meaning result.

questions.question: Choose the noun form of 'strong'.
questions.explanation: Strength is the noun form.

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: He has been absent ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Since is used with a starting point in time.
